_readme: Arabic/English announcement text for commits whose message we cannot amend — upstream Equicord commits pulled in by a merge. Key is any unambiguous commit sha prefix. Fill this in as part of the upstream merge so the push announces both languages. Commits we author ourselves should carry notify-ar:/notify-en: trailers instead; this file is only the fallback for foreign commits. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

51cc856.en: Added compact mode support to sric, so it renders correctly for anyone using the compact message layout instead of cozy.
